settings.serverDefaultsHelp: Default DNS and Keepalive values for clients using inheritance and new clients. Custom values are preserved. After changing them, import the .conf or QR again on the device.
settings.generatedPskHelp: The pre-shared key (PSK) is automatically generated as 32 random bytes unique to this client, stored encrypted, and included in the issued .conf and QR.

settings.pskDisabledHelp: Pre-shared key (PSK): None · Not added automatically to avoid interrupting existing connections.
settings.savedSettingsHelp: Saved values take effect only after importing the configuration again on this device. After saving, download the .conf again or scan the QR again.

traffic.title: Client-side traffic
traffic.reportSummary: {ageKnown, select, yes {Last report {age, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} ago} other {No last report}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Agent report interval {interval, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {Agent report interval unknown}} · Only handshakes within the last 120 seconds are classified as online; this does not guarantee connectivity.
traffic.countersHelp: Totals are the peer counters last reported by the gateway and may restart from 0 after a restart or reactivation. Speed is the difference between new reports.

project.network.attachHelp: Attaching only adds a network interface to the gateway. Which destinations VPN clients send through the tunnel is set only by AllowedIPs (routing) below; leave it empty to add no routes. After changing routing, previously issued clients must download the .conf again.
project.diagnostics.heading: Agent connection diagnostics
project.diagnostics.unsupported: No diagnostics API: this Waygate version does not provide agent connection diagnostics. You can check the agent with the VM console log below.
project.diagnostics.error: Could not load agent connection diagnostics: {error}
project.diagnostics.staleError: Could not load the latest diagnostics; showing the previous result: {error}

project.diagnostics.selfCheck.reconcile: {state, select, ok {Configuration sync succeeded} failed {Configuration sync failed} other {Configuration sync result unknown}}
project.diagnostics.selfCheck.interface: {state, select, up {WireGuard interface up} down {WireGuard interface down} other {WireGuard interface state unknown}}
project.diagnostics.hint.agent_not_polli: The gateway agent has not fetched its configuration (desired-state) for over 90 seconds, so new clients are not applied as WireGuard peers. The agent in the gateway image is older than the Waygate API or has stopped. Check the agent service in the VM console log below, and recreate the server after the image/agent is updated.
project.diagnostics.hint.image_agent_out: The agent stopped fetching configuration right after registering. The agent in the gateway image is an older run-once version than the Waygate API expects. Recreate the server after the image/agent is updated.
project.diagnostics.hint.agent_never_rep: The agent has never registered or reported status yet. If the server was just created, wait a few minutes; if it persists, check cloud-init and agent errors in the VM console log below, then recreate the server.
project.diagnostics.hint.agent_status_st: The agent fetches configuration but has not reported status for over 90 seconds. The WireGuard interface or status collection may be failing; check agent errors in the VM console log below.
project.diagnostics.hint.peers_mismatch: The reported WireGuard peer count differs from the number of enabled clients. If you just changed clients, wait a moment; if it persists, check agent sync errors in the VM console log.
